subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if so should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds public config and cost-accounting semantics across model config, provider catalogs, session status, UI aggregation, and persisted USD-named fields; automation cannot choose that contract safely.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope, mixed-currency behavior, and display-versus-accounting semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces remain consistent.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave configured model pricing as USD estimates and handle provider billing currencies only through provider-usage snapshots.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol override while explicitly documenting that stored totals and telemetry remain USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope, mixed-currency behavior, and display-versus-accounting semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces remain consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest available history on usage cost reporting and the sampled USD cost contract surfaces.
